title: Harbor and Clock
author: Silas Kavanagh
blurb: Zephyrine Sterling, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
